items.text: HTTP reads · values and JSON text
Click Refresh on each source. Requests run independently; the clock and slider keep working while a response is pending.

Try it
• Change value or name in either JSON file, save it, then Refresh.
• Change one URL to a missing file: its error does not stop the other source.
• With a slow endpoint, move the slider and watch the clock during Loading.

Start node tools/serve-http-example.cjs for editor, Run and HTML. Add ?delay=2500 to either URL for a slow response. CORS and local-network permission still apply. Try the other sketches for polling, events and POST.
Automatic reads · one event per completed request
This source polls every two seconds and refreshes after a URL change. Its completed event appends each response to the log, even when two responses are identical.

Try /examples/http-reading.json to log the same JSON repeatedly. Add ?delay=2500 to see non-overlapping polls, or ?status=503 for an error. Turn Automatic reads off to pause polling. Manual Refresh remains available.
HTTP POST · build a payload, then send it explicitly
Changing fields only changes the draft JSON. Click Send on the POST component, or press the connected trigger. Each completed response is recorded in the log.
Optional: reuse a key for the same logical write.

The demo server keeps writes only in memory. Reusing a key with the same JSON returns the original response; changing the JSON under that key returns 409. No write is retried automatically. A timeout or response error cannot prove the server did not accept a write.
HTTP tables · a live flow or an editable dataset
Click Refresh. The same response feeds a read-only filter/chart and a separate editable Dataset. Edit a stored quantity, then Refresh again: Live mode replaces those edits with the new response.

Change a quantity below.
Refresh overwrites edits.
Source failures keep this copy.
HTTP owns the connection and current response. Dataset owns the records. Switch Dataset to Manual in Edit to copy only on Replace or Append.

Refresh changes a quantity. Try /examples/http-stock.json for fixed data, or add ?status=503 to the live endpoint: direct views become unavailable; the stored copy remains. Run discards changes on return; downloads are kept.
